audit_name: HVA-06 SC-05 Boundary & Evidence Sufficiency Audit
mode: READ-ONLY AUDIT / NO MODIFICATION / NO IMPLEMENTATION / STOP

research_questions.RQ1: Human 为什么能够区分 SC-05 的 TP 与 FP？
research_questions.RQ1_answer: Human 使用 neighboring text (page_context) 判断当前在 body text 还是 reference list，并识别 author-name pattern。S3 Signature 只包含 period+capital 但不包含上下文证据。
research_questions.RQ2: Human 用于区分 TP/FP 的 Evidence，是否已经存在于当前 DICE Evidence 层？
research_questions.RQ2_answer: PARTIALLY. page_context 存在于 P7 reviewer data 但不在 machine_eval/Evidence Pack。author-name recognition 不存在于任何系统模块。
research_questions.RQ3: Evidence Missing / Organization Gap / Signal Boundary Gap？
research_questions.RQ3_answer: PRIMARY=Organization Gap (page_context exists but not composed). SECONDARY=Semantic Boundary (author-name recognition is TYPE-F).
research_questions.RQ4: SC-05 是否应该继续作为 Reusable Signal？
research_questions.RQ4_answer: BOUNDARY_ONLY. period+capital 是必要条件但非充分条件。不应作为 Reusable Signal 继续使用，但 boundary 是真实的。

is11_source_bias.detail: All 3 IS-11 source cases are body text / figure caption sentence boundaries. None are in reference lists.
is11_source_bias.implication: Signal was validated without seeing reference list continuation counterexamples

tp_fp_analysis.tp_pattern: period ends COMPLETE sentence/unit, text_b starts genuinely NEW sentence/unit
tp_fp_analysis.fp_pattern: period ends PART of reference entry, text_b CONTINUES same reference entry

boundary_class_mislabeling.implication: boundary_class is human annotation with errors, cannot be used as reliable machine evidence

evidence_source_classification.summary: 4 items in Evidence Pack (TYPE-A), 4 items exist in P7 but not composed (TYPE-B), 1 composable (TYPE-D), 2 semantic (TYPE-F)

human_decision_dependency.tp_evidence: E1(period) + E2(capital) + E3(text content) + E4(grammar) + E8(body text context)
human_decision_dependency.fp_evidence: E1(period) + E2(capital) + E5(reference structure) + E6(author-name) + E8(neighboring text) + E7(bibliographic markers)
human_decision_dependency.critical_gap: S3 provides E1+E2+E3+E12. Human additionally needs E4+E5+E6+E8. The discriminating evidence (context + reference structure + author-name) is NOT in S3.

primary_bottleneck.description: page_context (neighboring text) exists in P7 reviewer data but NOT in machine_eval or Evidence Pack. If available, E5 (reference structure) and E7 (bibliographic markers) could be composed with deterministic rules.

secondary_bottleneck.description: Author-name recognition (E6) requires semantic knowledge. "Le." could be author surname or sentence fragment. Cannot be safely structured without world knowledge.
secondary_bottleneck.resolution: Accept as Semantic Boundary, do not force Learning

sc05_boundary_diagnosis.is11_bias: BODY_TEXT (all 3 source cases are body text/figure caption, no reference list cases)
sc05_boundary_diagnosis.fp_root_cause: period+capital ambiguous between (a) sentence boundary → KEEP_SEPARATE and (b) within-reference continuation → MERGE

boundary_evidence_available.within_reference_distinction: PARTIALLY: [N] detection available (TYPE-D), author-name recognition NOT available (TYPE-F)
boundary_evidence_available.if_page_context_added: ~3/5 FP catchable, ~2/5 FP remain as Semantic Boundary

observation_gap.reason: Evidence EXISTS (page_context in P7) but is NOT ORGANIZED. This is Evidence Organization Gap (CASE-B), not Observation Gap (CASE-C).
observation_gap.minimum_request_if_authorized: Add page_context to Evidence Pack L2 (source: P1 text extraction, already exists in pipeline). NOT a new observation. NOT requested in this audit.

reference_continuation_check.doi: NOT_AVAILABLE (in text, but not extracted as evidence)
reference_continuation_check.citation_marker: NOT_AVAILABLE ([N] in text, but not extracted as evidence)
reference_continuation_check.neighboring_text: EVIDENCE_NOT_COMPOSED (exists in P7 page_context, not in Evidence Pack)
reference_continuation_check.bibliography_structure: NOT_AVAILABLE (no module detects reference list structure)

reusable_signal_status.reason: period+capital is NECESSARY but NOT SUFFICIENT. Signal should not continue as Reusable Signal as-is, but boundary is real.
reusable_signal_status.rule_creation_reason: boundary_class has labeling errors (3/5 FP mislabeled). Reference list also contains TP cases. Human knowing reference is semantic (TYPE-F).
